summary: Data East and Toei Animation's 1985 LaserDisc interactive driving film, later known internationally on Sega CD as Road Avenger and on Mega-LD as Road Prosecutor.

entries.title: Road Blaster

emulation.emulator: Original arcade hardware / LaserDisc preservation setup / Sega CD emulator
emulation.notes: Use the arcade route for the primary; Sega CD/Mega-CD emulation is the practical localized fallback.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original LaserDisc presentation where preserved, otherwise CD-era video output

primary.why: Road Blaster was originally a 1985 LaserDisc arcade game with Toei animation; later MSX/X1 VHD, Sega CD/Mega-CD, LaserActive, PlayStation, Saturn, X68000, Windows, and iOS routes are ports or compilations. The arcade LaserDisc release is the reference version for visual fidelity and original presentation.
primary.how_to_play: Play on original arcade hardware or a legally configured LaserDisc preservation setup; use Sega CD/Mega-CD Road Avenger for an accessible localized home route if owned.

entries.remaster_caveats: 3DO/Turbo Blaster remained a prototype; Super Road Blaster for SNES and the later Amiga/CD32 conversions are unofficial and are not treated as official release platforms.
